info.title: DeployDotnet
info.description: Command-line tool that publishes a .NET web app or API and deploys it to DeployDotnet.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Publishes your .NET web app or API, zips the output, and uploads it to DeployDotnet for deployment. Run with no options to deploy using saved or auto-detected settings, or pass --proj/--api-token to configure a new target.

options.name: --proj
options.description: Path to the .csproj file to deploy.

options.name: --api-token
options.description: API token from the DeployDotnet UI. In CI, set the DEPLOYDOTNET_API_TOKEN environment variable instead.

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment variable(s) as KEY=VALUE. Can be repeated or space-separated.

options.name: --env-file
options.description: Path to a dotenv file of KEY=VALUE lines to send as environment variables. Keeps secrets out of shell history; --env values override entries from the file.

options.name: --save-config
options.description: Save the resolved config (excluding env vars) to .deploydotnet/config.json. [default: False]

options.name: --clear-config
options.description: Delete the saved .deploydotnet/config.json and exit. [default: False]

options.name: --check-config
options.description: Check whether the current folder has a saved deployment setup and report readiness. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show full deployment output instead of a single collapsing progress line. [default: False]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Minutes to allow for the zip upload and host build/deploy (not the local dotnet build). Default: 5. Raise this for a large package or a slow upload connection.
